title: IIT Delhi Convocation 2026: PM Modi To Confer Honours, Inaugurate AI-Powered Supercomputing Facility Tomorrow
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will be the chief guest at IIT Delhi’s 57th Convocation on August 8, where over 3,000 students will graduate. During the event, he will confer academic medals and inaugurate Param Pragya, an AI-powered high-performance supercomputer facility designed to boost research in artificial intelligence, data science, and advanced computing.
